description.narrative: The general objective of the program is to help reduce the housing deficit in Mexico by financing the construction of low-income housing and by funding financial intermediaries in order to facilitate access to housing for unaffiliated workers. The programs specific objectives are: (i) to increase the construction of low-income housing by providing credit to developers to boost housing stock (bridge loans); and (ii) to increase access to housing for workers unaffiliated with social security by providing credit solutions (mortgages, microloans, and self-construction loans)
